visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and pink highlights lies on an orange pillow, hugging a large grey plush otter. She has a distressed facial expression and looks toward the otter as if talking to it. The background is a neutral indoor room with green plants. (2) The woman stands up energetically, looking directly at the camera with a cheerful expression. She points a finger upward and gestures toward herself. She wears a floral patterned top over a white shirt. (3) A screen recording sequence begins, showing the App Store interface. A hand is not visible, but the screen navigates through searching for 'Apple 活動邀約', downloading the app, and going through the setup process. (4) The app interface shows the creation of a new event titled '交往三週年紀念日' with a snowy forest background image. Text inputs and toggle switches are adjusted. (5) The screen recording shows the iPhone home screen being edited, with various app icons shaking. A widget for the countdown event is added and resized. (6) The video cuts back to the woman sitting on a couch. she holds her smartphone and shows the screen to the plush otter, looking hopeful. (7) The camera focuses on the plush otter's face. (8) The woman grabs the plush otter's neck and shakes it with an angry, exaggerated facial expression. A final text screen appears on a light green background with icons.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你為什麼把我們紀念日的倒數日曆刪掉了. (2) [Subtitle]: 你一定是不愛我了. (3) [Subtitle]: 分手!!! (4) [Subtitle]: 感情問題一律...交給我. (5) [Subtitle]: 現在 iPhone 內建就可以新增倒數工具了. (6) [Subtitle]: 先在 App Store 下載 Apple 活動邀約. (7) [Logo]: Apple 活動邀約. (8) [Subtitle]: 如果已經下載的話，要先確定升級到 v1.4 或以上版本. (9) [Subtitle]: 再來就只要開啟 App. (10) [Subtitle]: 點選右上角的 「+」. (11) [Subtitle]: 建立新活動. (12) [Subtitle]: 就可以在活動標題輸入你想要倒數的事件. (13) [Subtitle]: 還可以加入背景. (14) [Subtitle]: 完成後點 預覽 下一步. (15) [Subtitle]: 接著回到桌面. (16) [Subtitle]: 長按空白處 點左上角的 編輯 加入小工具. (17) [Subtitle]: 就可以在列表內找到活動邀約. (18) [Subtitle]: 左右滑想要的尺寸. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後點下方的 加入小工具 就會顯示在桌面上了. (20) [Subtitle]: 那你設定好了吧 我看. (21) [Subtitle]: 哈 日曆咧. (22) [Subtitle]: 我沒買 iCloud 所以不能用啊. (23) [Subtitle]: 分手!!! (24) [Slogan]: 溫馨提醒 有 iCloud 才能建立活動 不然就只能接受別人的邀約喔.
